entries.title: Urban Drone Traffic Intersection
entries.description: A 3D city crossroads where dozens of small box-shaped drones follow colored flight lanes, slow at virtual “air-traffic lights,” avoid collisions, leave faint motion trails, and trigger changing status labels as they queue, pass, and occasionally reroute around a stationary “no-fly” tower.

entries.title: Drone Swarm Flocking Around a Beacon
entries.description: A swarm of small sphere-drones with arrow indicators uses simple flocking rules to orbit a glowing central beacon, splitting into sub-swarms, merging again, avoiding collisions, and leaving color-coded trails that show their changing paths and velocities.

entries.title: Warehouse Inventory Drones and Shelf System
entries.description: A bright warehouse grid with shelves (stationary boxes) and quadcopter drones that pick up small colored packages, attach them under their bodies, fly them along marked air corridors, avoid each other, drop them in delivery zones, and display labels showing package IDs and drone load.

entries.title: Search-and-Rescue Drones Over Disaster Terrain
entries.description: A hilly terrain with rubble blocks where drones hover low, scan the surface with rotating cones of light, drop small marker beacons on detected “victims” (colored spheres), communicate by drawing temporary glowing lines between themselves, and occasionally land to recharge at a central station.

entries.title: Drone Racing Circuit with Gates and Obstacles
entries.description: A race track in the air with floating hoops, pylons, and moving barriers, where multiple drones accelerate, bank, and weave through gates, leaving colored trails that fade over time, while collisions with obstacles cause bounces, spins, and temporary “damage” indicators over each drone.

entries.title: Package-Delivery Drones in a Suburban Neighborhood
entries.description: A patchwork of houses with mailboxes where delivery drones take off from a central depot, pick up box parcels, fly along semi-random yet efficient paths, avoid trees and power poles, gently descend to drop parcels at doorsteps, and show status labels (“en route,” “delivering,” “returning”) above each body.

entries.title: Drone Swarm Mapping a 3D Cave
entries.description: A transparent cave mesh with stalagmites and stalactites where a formation of small drones moves in, scatters to explore, uses colored scanning beams to “paint” a gradually appearing wireframe map, and then regroups and exits, leaving a ghostly 3D map floating above the terrain.

entries.title: Drone vs. Wind Tunnel Simulation
entries.description: A drone hovering in a wind tunnel with visible airflow particles streaming past; the drone tilts and adjusts thrust to maintain position as wind speed changes, its orientation and force vectors shown as arrows, while collisions with invisible gusts push it off-center and trigger corrective movements.
